# Submit Assignment

## Summary
Creates Submission v(n+1) as submitted; supersedes an open earlier version.

## Refuses when
enrolment not active; before opensAt; after hard close; graded and no resubmission allowed.

## Non-goals
Business rules beyond those listed belong to the consumer.

## Example
The linked submission is a first version; submitting again creates the next version.
attributes.cardDescription: Hands in a new version of an assignment, superseding an open earlier one, within the assignment's submission window.
